name: search_digimon
description: Search the Digimon API by name (partial match) and list Digimon creatures. Omit name to list all. Returns id, name, and image for each match. Keyless.

name.description: Partial Digimon name to search for. Omit to list all Digimon.

name: get_digimon
description: Get full details for one Digimon by name or numeric id: its level, type, attribute, fields, evolution lines, and English description. Keyless.

name.description: A Digimon name like "Agumon" or a numeric id like "1".
